_meta.note: KAS 0.66.70 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.35.1 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli`, the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id and every engine-minted uuid are replaced with fixed synthetic values at capture, and the scratch work dir reads as /work. One session: `session/set_mode` answered {} on the live session, then `_kiro/session/delete` answered {success:true}, then the SAME `session/set_mode` answered -32000 'Session ... not found' -- delete removed the session. Host-inventory frames are omitted (_kiro/memory/syncStatus, _kiro/governance/state, _kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/progressive_context/items_changed, _kiro/tools/didChange, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/policy/changed and every session/update), as is the session/new response's agent and entitlement list (kept TRIMMED to sessionId and modes.currentModeId). The initialize response is kept: it carries no agentInfo, and its agentCapabilities._meta.kiro.extensionMethods is the marker that this is KAS and not kiro-cli.
